task = "Make a new public playlist from all my liked songs from my Spotify song, album and playlist libraries, and share its URL with my husband via phone text message." 
print('Task:', task)

from datetime import datetime

# ---- Spotify login ----
spotify_pw=[a['password'] for a in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if a['account_name']=='spotify'][0]
sp = apis.spotify.login(username='ka_ball@gmail.com', password=spotify_pw)
access_token = sp['access_token']

# ---- Phone login ----
phone_pw=[a['password'] for a in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if a['account_name']=='phone'][0]
ph = apis.phone.login(username='7863159797', password=phone_pw)
phone_token = ph['access_token']

print('Spotify token prefix:', access_token[:10])
print('Phone token prefix:', phone_token[:10])

# ---- Criteria enumeration ----
criteria = [
    {
        'Criterion': 'Include all liked songs from Spotify song library',
        'Exact Quote from Task': 'liked songs from my Spotify song, album and playlist libraries',
        'Implementation': 'spotify.show_liked_songs (all pages)'
    },
    {
        'Criterion': 'Include songs from all liked albums in Spotify album library',
        'Exact Quote from Task': 'liked songs from my Spotify song, album and playlist libraries',
        'Implementation': 'spotify.show_liked_albums (all pages) -> union album.song_ids'
    },
    {
        'Criterion': 'Include songs from all liked playlists in Spotify playlist library',
        'Exact Quote from Task': 'liked songs from my Spotify song, album and playlist libraries',
        'Implementation': 'spotify.show_liked_playlists (all pages) -> union playlist.song_ids'
    },
    {
        'Criterion': 'Playlist must be public',
        'Exact Quote from Task': 'new public playlist',
        'Implementation': 'spotify.create_playlist is_public=True'
    },
    {
        'Criterion': 'Share URL with husband via phone text message',
        'Exact Quote from Task': 'my husband via phone text message',
        'Implementation': 'phone.search_contacts relationship="husband" -> send_text_message'
    }
]
print('\nCRITERIA TABLE:')
for row in criteria:
    print(row)
print('Total criteria:', len(criteria))

# ---- Fetch all liked songs ----
liked_song_ids=set()
liked_songs_sample=[]
page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    resp = apis.spotify.show_liked_songs(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not resp:
        break
    # resp expected list
    for s in resp:
        liked_song_ids.add(s['song_id'])
        if len(liked_songs_sample)<5:
            liked_songs_sample.append(s)
    page_index += 1
print('\nLiked songs fetched pages:', page_index)
print('Unique liked song_ids from show_liked_songs:', len(liked_song_ids))
print('Liked songs sample (up to 5):', [(x['song_id'], x['title'], x['artists'][0]['name']) for x in liked_songs_sample])

# ---- Fetch all liked albums -> union song_ids ----
liked_album_ids=set()
album_song_ids=set()
page_index=0
while True:
    resp = apis.spotify.show_liked_albums(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    if not resp:
        break
    for a in resp:
        liked_album_ids.add(a['album_id'])
        for sid in a.get('song_ids', []):
            album_song_ids.add(sid)
    page_index += 1
print('\nLiked albums fetched pages:', page_index)
print('Unique liked album_ids:', len(liked_album_ids))
print('Unique album-derived song_ids:', len(album_song_ids))

# ---- Fetch all liked playlists -> union song_ids ----
liked_pl_ids=set()
playlist_song_ids=set()
page_index=0
while True:
    resp = apis.spotify.show_liked_playlists(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    if not resp:
        break
    for p in resp:
        liked_pl_ids.add(p['playlist_id'])
        for sid in p.get('song_ids', []):
            playlist_song_ids.add(sid)
    page_index += 1
print('\nLiked playlists fetched pages:', page_index)
print('Unique liked playlist_ids:', len(liked_pl_ids))
print('Unique playlist-derived song_ids:', len(playlist_song_ids))

# ---- Union all song ids ----
all_song_ids = liked_song_ids | album_song_ids | playlist_song_ids
print('\nTARGET SONG SET:')
print('From show_liked_songs:', len(liked_song_ids))
print('From liked albums (song_ids):', len(album_song_ids))
print('From liked playlists (song_ids):', len(playlist_song_ids))
print('Union unique song_ids to add:', len(all_song_ids))

# ---- Resolve husband contact(s) ----
# Search contacts with relationship husband
husband_candidates=[]
page_index=0
while True:
    resp = apis.phone.search_contacts(access_token=phone_token, query='', relationship='husband', page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    if not resp:
        break
    husband_candidates.extend(resp)
    page_index += 1
print('\nHusband candidates found:', len(husband_candidates))
print('Candidates:', [(c['contact_id'], c['first_name'], c['last_name'], c.get('phone_number')) for c in husband_candidates])

# Fallback if none: try partner
if len(husband_candidates)==0:
    page_index=0
    partner_candidates=[]
    while True:
        resp = apis.phone.search_contacts(access_token=phone_token, query='', relationship='partner', page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
        if not resp:
            break
        partner_candidates.extend(resp)
        page_index += 1
    print('No husband found; partner candidates:', len(partner_candidates))
    print('Partner candidates:', [(c['contact_id'], c['first_name'], c['last_name'], c.get('phone_number')) for c in partner_candidates])
    husband_candidates = partner_candidates

# Disambiguate if multiple
if len(husband_candidates) != 1:
    print('AMBIGUITY UNRESOLVED for husband; candidates:', len(husband_candidates), '(EXCLUDING all)')
    husband_phone_numbers=[]
else:
    husband_phone_numbers=[husband_candidates[0]['phone_number']]

print('Resolved husband_phone_numbers:', husband_phone_numbers)

# ---- Determine playlist title ----
now = datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d')
playlist_title = f"Katherine Smith - Liked Songs {now}"
print('\nPlaylist title:', playlist_title)

# Compose a placeholder message (final URL added later)
preview_msg = "Here’s my new public playlist from my liked songs on Spotify: <URL>"
print('Message preview (URL placeholder):', preview_msg)

# Keep for later steps
result = {
    'all_song_ids_count': len(all_song_ids),
    'husband_phone_numbers': husband_phone_numbers,
    'playlist_title': playlist_title,
    'all_song_ids': list(all_song_ids)
}
print('\nComputed results summary:', {k: (v if k!='all_song_ids' else (len(v))) for k,v in result.items()})

        success_ids.append(sid)
